notes.title: Money or your life?
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45438602/5099deb4eef34a2a18214acc285070631ea48c33.png[/img]

[i][b][u]You give us five gold coins and we’ll give you x̶͑e̴͐n̷͋o̸͘m̷͒a̵̽n̵̈́u̶͐s̵̈́ c̴͒r̴͌ ĩ̵p̸͂t̸̎, ok?[/u][/b][/i]

If you confidently said yes, this one’s for you 
Wayone Games presents: Deadly Deals — a brand new title where you’ll step into the shoes of an antique dealer… with a very special inventory.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45438602/77d73eb0e38da1769712a35fd36b0201a508d623.png[/img]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45438602/4a76bb5b46556ece456eeac8340c038357895b3b.png[/img]

The story begins when you start selling secondhand goods in a new, eerie location (anything to save on rent, right?). You pay for your stall, buy and sell things, grow your business… Everything seems fine, until one day, you wake up unlucky enough to buy yourself ▉▉▉▉▉▉▉▉.

Suddenly, there are whispers in the dark. A strange mist appears. You feel watched, constantly. Just try to survive and keep your shop running 

In Deadly Deals, your choices matter: sometimes they lead to profit, sometimes to panic attacks. You might make good money on junk… or find out that junk is cursed.
Choose wisely, investigate thoroughly, and always stay alert: your predecessor didn’t make it out.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45438602/741d5b301250523c0f8471c806e9cff2156e25d8.png[/img]

To make your antique dealer life just a bit more exciting, Deadly Deals features:

- A shifting atmosphere that slides from calm commerce to full-on paranormal chaos
- Engaging gameplay with resource management and shop economics
- A hauntingly mysterious story to help uncover what’s wrong with this place
- Detective elements — you'll have to figure out exactly what (or who) angered the spirits
- A constant, lingering sense of the unknown

Feel free to add Deadly Deals to your wishlist — it definitely doesn’t contain any ghosts, demons, or… other things. Deal?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3660360/Deadly_Deals/
